# BlueGay Pride logo

Generated with the built-in image generation tool from the user's blue jay reference. The original transparent PNG is `bluegay-pride-logo.png`. The IDE header, welcome screen and browser favicon use it. Square PNG and ICO copies in `src-tauri/icons/pride-icon.*` are configured for the future desktop app; no executable was compiled.

Generation prompt:

> Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished logo symbol for BlueGay, a programming IDE. Input image is a reference: preserve the recognizable left-facing blue jay head silhouette, crest, beak and bold curved cheek markings. Refine into a crisp minimal flat logo with strong clean edges, suitable for an app icon. Keep blue as the dominant color with dark navy outlines and light face areas. Integrate LGBTQ+ Pride features as elegant six-color rainbow feather bands on the neck, with a small harmonious light blue, pink and white accent in the crest. Confident and welcoming, readable at small sizes. Single centered standalone bird head mark, generous transparent margin, genuinely transparent background. No lettering, no mockup, no shadows, no extra symbols, no sheet of variants. Keep the spirit of the attached blue jay while making an original clean professional mark.
